summary: Project is metadata on a particular mob/composition; there is no single MDB-global Project and no universal native file-before-master priority.
Direct Project lookup tries the owner’s _PJ and only if not found tries PROJNAME. A present blank _PJ stops both PROJNAME and higher-level native FindProjectName fallback.

Native inherited Project lookup can inspect _USER._PJ and then linked source compositions, in track/graph traversal order. It stops on the first found applicable value rather than comparing all candidates.

Native cache consumers start from different owners: AddMobIDToDir starts from its supplied master; PMR v1 recovery starts from its file mob. Media Tool PMR Project chooser separately uses cached PMR Project and can substitute current-project context for empty input.

Bella can choose a conservative physical-file-centered lookup explicitly, while preserving missing, blank, unusable and conflicting states internally. That proposal is separate from a claim of exact native behavior.

bellaProposalNotApproval.startingOwner: For a physical media row, start at the MDB file mob matched by complete FileMobId. Read only Project values belonging to that owner and explicitly linked source ancestors.
bellaProposalNotApproval.sameOwner: Evaluate direct _PJ before legacy key PROJNAME; a valid blank can be recorded as present blank, independently of missing/unusable. Local _USER._PJ is a distinct nested location, not any arbitrary project-named attribute elsewhere.
bellaProposalNotApproval.sourceFallback: If approved as desired fallback, follow explicit SourceID ancestry only, bound cycles, and retain owner/provenance. Native paths are first-found, but Bella can conservatively decline ambiguous or conflicting source values rather than choose arbitrary objects.
bellaProposalNotApproval.excludedInference: Do not substitute current open project, flatten archived bin/user columns, or scan unrelated masters merely because they refer to the same file. A master-first policy could be chosen explicitly, but it is not implied by native universal ordering.
bellaProposalNotApproval.decisionLeftForParent: Choose when valid blank stops fallback and whether _USER/source inheritance belongs in first release. This receipt reports native distinctions; it does not modify approved requirements.

owner.result: Project lookup starts from the matched file SourceMob, not the master selected for Clip Name.
owner.trace: PMR FileMobId bytes 16..23 form an eight-byte lookup key into SourceMobs; matched local Bento object ID resolves to first TOC index. addInfoToItem invokes getProjectNameForObjAt with that file TOC index at 0x100064ab8.
owner.qualification: This eight-byte join is an observed MDVx shortcut. Bella already requires full normalized IDs; it must not be copied.

directAttributePrecedence.result: Direct file Project is tried first. Any nonnil NSString, including empty or whitespace-only, returns immediately.
trace: 0x100064e10 branches to return cleanup; no length/space check

sourceFallback.trigger: Only a nil direct-file Project result enters the source fallback.
path: Resolve SourceID through SourceMobs index to local object
Call getProjectAttributeForObjectAt: directly on resolved source
sourceFallback.depth: One relationship level only. The source call at 0x100064ffc is getProjectAttributeForObjectAt:, not recursive getProjectNameForObjAt:. No further source ancestry is searched by this path.
sourceFallback.ids: SourceID length 32 uses bytes 16..23; length 12 uses bytes 4..11. Other lengths take a diagnostic branch. Neither width supplies a full canonical identity in MDVx.
sourceFallback.selection: The loops continue over all tracks and source entries in stored order. Each resolved source replaces the candidate with its direct attribute result, including nil or empty. Therefore the last resolved source result wins; it is not first found, first nonempty, unique-source, or best-source selection.
sourceFallback.unresolvedSource: A failed SourceMobs lookup skips that source without replacing the current candidate. A resolved source with no Project does replace it with nil.
sourceFallback.qualification: This does not cover arbitrary direct source-clip components or nested component forms lacking the required Sequence property; no general recursive graph search is implemented in this routine.

attributeSelection.keyMatch: Case-sensitive first three raw bytes _PJ only. Instructions 0x1000652d8..0x1000652ec compare two bytes _P and third J; do not test a following NUL or exact total length. A longer raw name beginning _PJ can match.
attributeSelection.valueRead: At 0x1000652f8 calls GetStringForObjectAt: from the matched Name TOC index + 1. No attribute Kind-aware dispatch occurs in this route.
attributeSelection.duplicates: Continues scanning attribute refs and replaces candidate at 0x100065310 for every matching _PJ prefix, including a nil/empty returned value. Last matching prefix wins.
attributeSelection.PROJNAME: No PROJNAME alternative in either traced Project helper. Corroborating whole universal executable byte search found zero occurrences; absence of a literal alone is not used as a general proof about unrelated app behavior.

textDecoding.reader: Generic GetStringForObjectAt: scans the same object from the supplied TOC index and returns the first accepted string property, not a type-aware attribute-string decoder.
textDecoding.encoding: 0x100063b30..0x100063b40: _isII true selects Foundation encoding 1 (NSASCIIStringEncoding), otherwise encoding 30 (NSMacOSRomanStringEncoding). openFile 0x100061d28..0x100061d38 sets _isII from label extra bytes 0x4949.
textDecoding.trimming: 0x100063b74 trims leading/trailing NUL characters only. No whitespace trim and no normalization of an existing nonempty string was found.
textDecoding.kind4: This route does not decode known UTF8 Kind 4 Blob/BobData attributes or follow a named Unicode Project property. A generic BOB field must not be assumed to be a UTF8 alternative.
textDecoding.priorMeasuredExample: Copied prior Foundation converter and exact MacRoman A7 Project specimen demonstrate that encoding 1 returns section sign U+00A7 rather than sharp-s U+00DF for that byte. See Foundation-actual-pj-720p.txt, actual-pj-path.json and check_actual_nsstring.m.
textDecoding.qualification: Database browser StringForTocIndexItem: has a different explicit UTF8 file-path branch. That browser behavior must not be generalized to this ordinary scanner Project route. Bella approved decoding differs from this observed MDVx implementation.

actualDatabases.purpose: Independent read-only owner-aware MDB Project observation using cached raw values and actual sibling PMRs. No production or media writes.
method: PMR v16 Project read as approvedMacRoman for comparison only; no cross-source preference selected.
Complete IDs select unique catalogue file and PMR-associated master objects; local object references establish catalogue membership.
Project attributes are located through CPNT:Attributes -> ATTR:AttrRefs. Direct own _PJ results are counted separately from nested _USER/_IMPORTSETTING or other nested paths.
No arbitrary nested Name/PreservedBinData column is promoted into Project. PROJNAME and Kind4 occurrences are reported independently.
Immediate source candidates follow only the file-own track/component tree to exact SCLP:SourceID targets in the source catalogue. No arbitrary first source or master is substituted.
Whitespace determines usability only; nonblank stored spelling is preserved for exact equality comparison.
Counts state perPMRfile versus distinct owner objects explicitly; one master can describe multiple audio/video files.
limits: All actualPMRs store Project; no genuine missing-PMR-Project fallback case exercised.
Direct _PJ result counters do not choose a PROJNAME fallback or cross-owner/cross-source priority.

The separate master owner may describe a different provenance; agreement where values exist is evidence, not permission to borrow it universally.
Malformed Unicode/unknown encoding and missing optional properties are not guessed from successful ASCII or MacRoman decoding.
No bulk raw Project names, transcription text, lyrics or private binary payloads are copied.

agreedBellaRule.status: Approved by user on 19 October 2026; not implemented.
agreedBellaRule.fieldMeaning: Recorded media-project association; not a guarantee of original creation project or current open project.
agreedBellaRule.primaryOwner: MDB catalogue-qualified physical file mob matched by complete normalized FileMobId; independent of the master selected for Clip Name.
sameOwnerCandidatesInOrder: Exact local _USER object-attribute list, then exact _PJ within that list
agreedBellaRule.encoding: Apply already approved typed, known-field Unicode/legacy decoding to each exact candidate. PROJNAME is a key alternative, not an established Unicode partner. Do not reinterpret malformed UTF8 as MacRoman.
agreedBellaRule.usable: Readable supported text with at least one non-whitespace character. Preserve original nonblank spelling, case and spacing; whitespace is used only for the blank test.
agreedBellaRule.candidateFallback: Absent, blank or individually unusable text can advance to the next recognized same-owner candidate only when structural boundaries and ownership remain safely readable. Blank is not corruption.
agreedBellaRule.sourceFallback: Only after no same-owner candidate is usable: follow the file own supported track/component references to immediate SourceID targets, resolving full normalized IDs in the appropriate source catalogue. Apply the same local candidate order to those source owners. No recursive referenced-mob ancestry search for release one.
agreedBellaRule.sourceSelection: Accept one distinct usable Project, or exact agreement among all usable immediate-source Projects, only when relevant references are sufficiently readable and resolved to establish this result. Missing/blank source Project is normal. Conflicting values or incomplete/ambiguous relationships leave MDB Project unavailable; no first/last-object-order selection.
agreedBellaRule.conflictingDuplicateCandidates: Different usable values for repeated same-priority exact keys are conflict, not ordinary absence; do not hide the conflict by taking a later key or source. Identical duplicates can agree. This case was not observed in the corpus.
doNotSubstitute: Arbitrary nested _IMPORTSETTING, archived bin columns or unrelated project-like attributes
agreedBellaRule.noUsableResult: Leave MDB-derived Project unavailable/blank and keep physical inventory row; do not invent a placeholder project name.
agreedBellaRule.compactProvenance: Keep only the resolved value plus compact availability/conflict and chosen owner/key origin needed by reconciliation; no lasting full raw graph.
